faq.private.a: No. The file is read inside your browser and never leaves your device. The site uses no analytics, no ads and no cookies.
faq.which.q: There are several map files. Which one is mine?
faq.which.a: Each character has its own folder, in the same order as in the game. Inside, every world and server you played has a numbered file. The most recently changed one is usually the world you are playing.
faq.rings.q: Why is a boss not exactly on its ring?
faq.rings.a: Rings show the distance from the Core at which a boss or dungeon spawns. The exact angle is random, but it is always inside its biome: turn on “Crop rings to their biome” to narrow it down.
faq.maze.a: Mazes in the Stone biome spawn in places you haven’t explored yet. The tool finds unexplored spaces big enough for each maze size. Green fits the large maze, cyan the medium and pink the small one.
faq.gemstone.q: Where are the Clear Gemstone and the Chipped Blade?
faq.gemstone.a: Spoiler: the Chipped Blade is in a temple in the Wilderness. The Clear Gemstone is in the medium maze, which you can look for with Maze holes.
faq.unknown.a: Its colour isn’t in the tile list yet, often because it is new in a game update. Use “Report these colours” in Find tiles and we’ll add it.
faq.mobile.q: Does it work on phones and tablets?
faq.mobile.a: Yes. Copy your map file to the device and open it here. Live updates only work on desktop Chrome and Edge.
